content.tagline: Cosmeceuticals and device-based care for clinics and salons — from a Korean developer
content.descriptor: iCELmedi Co., Ltd., a Korean developer of cellmedics cosmeceuticals and KERASON devices; manufacturing at partner facilities
about: iCELmedi Co., Ltd. (주식회사 아이셀메디텍) is a Korean company working at the intersection of professional cosmetics and device-based care. Founded in 2014, it was incorporated as its current legal entity in 2024, and in 2025 it expanded and relocated its production and office base to Goyang (Gyeonggi Province). The company runs two complementary directions: the cellmedics cosmeceutical line for professional and home care, and KERASON devices for salons, aesthetic medicine clinics and training centres.

In-house development is built around four technologies stated by the company: protein and growth factor recombination, biomimetic peptide synthesis, plant callus cultivation and extraction, and a specialisation in high-power ultrasound. Finished products are made at certified partner facilities — iCELmedi acts as the brand owner, formulation developer and production organiser, including OEM/ODM under the customer's own brand.

A separate direction is training: the company runs integrated programmes for aestheticians and partners through its own IBWA academy (International Beauty Wellness Academy). This matters for a device distributor: the equipment comes together with a working methodology, treatment protocols and staff training.

lines.name: cellmedics — professional care
lines.note: Cosmeceuticals for salon and home use: cleansing, toning, serums, ampoules, creams and masks. Large formats (500–1,000 ml, 1 kg) are intended for treatment-room work, compact ones for home care and retail.

lines.name: Cica Clear — for sensitive and problem skin
lines.note: A line based on Centella asiatica: toner, serum, ampoule and cream for skin prone to redness and breakouts. Combines into a complete care protocol.

lines.name: Biocell Multi — recovery and firmness
lines.note: A multifunctional line with chitosan and a growth factor complex: toner, serum, ampoule and cream. Stated by the company as dual-function functional cosmetics — brightening and wrinkle care.

lines.name: KERASON — device-based care
lines.note: The KERASON PRIME device based on high-power ultrasound and electric vibration, three handpiece types for different tasks and two professional activators, Pure AT and Pure ST. Per the company's documentation, the unit falls into the household and salon category and is not a medical device.

tech.name: Growth factors and protein recombination
tech.note: The company's in-house competency in obtaining and stabilising protein complexes; the Biocell Multi line and the recovery creams are built on it.

tech.name: Biomimetic peptides and plant callus
tech.note: Synthesis of peptides that replicate structures natural to the skin, and cultivation of plant cells to obtain active extracts.

tech.name: High-power ultrasound, 20–32 kHz
tech.note: The KERASON technology: low-frequency ultrasonic waves are converted into high-power waves and delivered into the skin together with electric vibration. The patent for KERASON PRIME was registered in Korea in 2026 (as stated by the company).

tech.name: Full-cycle OEM/ODM
tech.note: Product planning, formulation development, packaging design, manufacturing at a partner facility and export support. The minimum OEM/ODM batch is from 3,000 units.

content.exportNote: As stated by the company, its products are supplied to the USA, Hong Kong, Australia, Vietnam, the UK and Thailand; an exclusive distributor operates in Indonesia. For a number of markets — China, Malaysia, the UK, the USA and Dubai — the company reports signed memoranda of understanding; final agreements are still under negotiation, so these territories are not considered closed. The delivery basis is FOB Korea. The company's priority directions are China, Japan, the UK, the USA, France and Taiwan.

terms.label: Minimum order
terms.value: From 100 units per item (modelling masks — from 30); OEM/ODM — from 3,000 units

terms.label: Prices
terms.value: Wholesale and distributor levels; separate terms apply to the KERASON PRIME device, including exclusive terms at a volume of 50 units or more per year

terms.label: Payment
terms.value: 100% T/T; terms are discussed in the contract

terms.label: Production lead time
terms.value: 50–60 days after order confirmation; delivery times depend on the market and registration requirements

content.consentNote: The data and materials are provided by iCELmedi Co., Ltd. and published with its written consent dated 5 August 2026. Information on certifications, registrations and the manufacturing model is stated by the company and is subject to documentary confirmation at the deal stage. Professional preparations for injection and mesotherapy use are not featured in the showcase.
